lines.text: Snow White follows Liliweiss outside the base.
Along the horizon, Rapture troops are rallying.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: There are so many of them!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Yeah, more than I expected.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Have they sniffed out our base?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: If they have, we'll have to relocate.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: We will?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Yes. If our location has been exposed, the invasions will be relentless.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: There's only one thing to do:

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: eliminate them before they have a chance to find us.
Liliweiss stretches her arms and takes a step forward.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You're not going out there, are you?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Alone?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: The others aren't ready yet.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Those of us who are, should head out first.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I've got a lot of friends back there in that base.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I have to protect them.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: With this beauty of a weapon you've made me, this is gonna be a cakewalk.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I've already told you, I haven't finished testing it! You mustn't us...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You made this especially for me.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: That's all I need to know.
Liliweiss rushes towards the Raptures,
unsheathes the sword forged by Snow White,
and begins to slash to and fro.
*Crash*
The Raptures at the front of the pack collapse to the ground.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Still intact.
*Beep*
*Kachink*

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: How do I reload the gun portion?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Like this?
*Whirrrr* *Kachink*

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: That doesn't sound quite right...
Liliweiss aims at the Raptures.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Shouldn't be a problem.
*Crash*
At the moment she pulls the trigger, the gun shatters.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I suppose asking it to hold on twice was too much.
*Whew*
A Rapture ambushes Liliweiss from behind.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Lilith! Behind you!
*Crash*
Liliweiss runs her hand clean through the Rapture's body, impaling it.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Snow White.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Sorry about that.
*Crash*

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I always end up underestimating my own strength.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll still find a way to use it, albeit somewhat unconventionally.
Liliweiss picks up a shard of the weapon,
bends it into a curved shape,
*Crash*
then rams it through a Rapture's head.
Liliweiss rushes toward the sprawling Raptures horde off in the distance.
Wherever she runs, Raptures are torn apart in her wake.
She will not allow a single Rapture to lay a hand on Snow White.
She is simultaneously the last line of defense between mankind and utter ruination,
and the ultimate weapon,
the most powerful of her kind ever crafted by human hands.
She is the personification of victory itself.
Snow White can't take her eyes off her.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Wow...
That's when Lilith unveiled her true nature to me for the first time.
Her strength was overwhelming,
entirely different from all other Nikkes.
There was a purity to it that was unexplainable.
There before me...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: was the true Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Whew... that took a bit longer than expected.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I broke your weapon, again.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Sorry too for freaking out back there

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: when the gun fell apart.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ...Splendid.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You were splendid!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: That was absolutely incredible, Lilith.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I finally know why they consider you mankind's last hope.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You possess a power that no Nikke, nor any Rapture, could ever hope to compete with.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: That's why you haven't found any weapons that complement you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: There's no room for improvement with you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Your existence alone is sheer perfection.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Jeez, don't you think you're building me up a bit too much?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Not at all. I know I'm not wrong about this.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: When I saw you fighting, I could see straight away

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: that you must not wield any weapons.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Anything in your hand would only become a hindrance,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: something incongruous with your innate design.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Your entire body, from head to toe,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: has been designed to unleash this overwhelming power.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hmm. I see.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'm glad you think so highly of me,

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: but you know something?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I noticed you've started calling me Lilith.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: About time, I say.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I just got a bit...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I was... going to call you that once the weapon was finished.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: But once I realized you had no need for any weapons,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I thought there might not be another opportune moment to call you that, so...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Gotcha.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You really are a cutie pie.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I really don't like it when you call me cute...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It's a bit of a shame though.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: It was a joy watching you make weapons for me.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I got a real kick out of it,

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: but now you're going to hang up your gloves.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I'll keep doing it.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You will?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: But didn't you just say there was no weapon suitable for me?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I... I can...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I can be your weapon, Lilith.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I may not have any special fighting abilities, but I'm skilled at making weapons.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: So long as I wield those, I should be of some use at least.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: In a way, the weapons that I craft can be yours as well.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Awww!
Liliweiss tussles Snow White's hair.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Heh-heh, I'm so moved.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... Okay. There will be a day

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: when you become my secret weapon.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Until then, I'll be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: she protected you when the chips were down, and you started calling her "Lilith"?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: That's all you got out of that entire story?!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Just kidding.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Becoming a weapon for someone else...

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Pretty cool, hehe.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Nothing so dramatic as that. I just... I wanted to lend Lilith a hand.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: That's exactly what I'm talking about. Super cool.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: When confronted with Lilith's power, the thought of helping her wouldn't even cross most people's minds.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: They'd just regard her as an aberration,

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: a freakish entity that

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: they could rely on for protection.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Lilith isn't a freak!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Anyway, I feel like there's nothing I can do to help her...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I'm always afraid that I won't be able to keep my promise.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Just trust me when I say you did a good job.
The commander tussles Snow White's hair.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Thanks for the stories,

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: cutie-pie.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: I like it when we spend time together like this.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Don't be a stranger.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Besides, staring at a computer monitor like that all day is bad for your eyes.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Nikkes don't suffer from any visual impairment.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Yeah yeah, I get it. Nikkes are the best and humans are weak and vulnerable.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: You know what I mean.
The commander leaves his seat.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Snow White.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: You can do it.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Don't let your doubts get the best of you. You're one of the Goddesses yourself.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: So long.
The commander leaves.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: What's gotten into the Commander today?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: But...
You can do it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I've got someone in my corner.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I can't disappoint them.
*Clink clank*
Snow White resumes assembling the weapon before her,
so that she can fulfill the promise she once made to her hero.
So that one day,
she can finally become Liliweiss's weapon.
